summary: v38 — Per-bayi threshold config + score histogram + plugin-health alarm fully verified. 15/15 new backend tests PASS. Regression: 54/54 prior v35+v36+v37 tests still PASS. Frontend: score-histogram renders with all 4 bars (clean/suspicious/spam/high) showing real counts (~1050/3/4/32); Settings Save Changes button correctly invokes BOTH POST /api/settings/update AND POST /api/events/thresholds.

integration_issues.issue: Browser call to POST /api/events/thresholds returns 400 because the SPA does not attach master auth (no x-master-key header, no gws_master_session cookie in this preview session, no license_key query param). The mutation swallows the error in try/catch so UX is unaffected ('Policy saved' toast still shown) and legacy /api/settings/update succeeds. Per-license thresholds therefore only get persisted when Settings is used from an authenticated master browser session. Recommend: (a) send license_key param derived from localStorage.getItem('gws.event_license') in api.setThresholds(), OR (b) automatically forward the same master session cookie the panel already relies on.

action_items: MINOR: Settings.js → api.setThresholds should pass license_key from localStorage (gws.event_license) so the browser call to /api/events/thresholds succeeds instead of returning 400 (currently swallowed). Backend endpoint itself is verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/events.py ingest handler reads db.licenses per-event to fetch spam_threshold/high_spam_threshold on EVERY ingest — high-traffic bayilerde 1 mongo lookup per mail. Consider LRU cache with short TTL (~30s) keyed by license_key to reduce load; invalidate on POST /events/thresholds.

server.py::_plugin_normalization_scan_once is bg-tasked every 30 min AND called synchronously from POST /admin/plugin-health/scan. Manual endpoint passes dedupe_hours=0 which bypasses dedup entirely — running it multiple times in succession CAN create duplicate alerts (verified: created was >0 on both back-to-back calls when threshold=1). Consider a floor (e.g., min(dedupe_hours,1)) even for manual invocation, or an admin flag to force-recreate rather than default-off dedup.

quarantine_stats uses TWO different tenancy fields — quarantine.owner_license_key vs mail_events.license_key. This is functionally correct but worth documenting (owner_license_key is quarantine-specific, mail_events uses raw license_key). Consider unifying to reduce mental overhead.

Thresholds ThresholdIn model allows values up to 50.0 but SA scores are typically <30; the ingest handler clamps total_score at 30 when SA is absent. Consider aligning: cap high_spam_threshold at 30 to avoid mis-configuring bayis into effectively-never-blocking states.
